pairs.target: yīwén tīng wán xī qú nàliàngchē de shì , xiān wèn de shì wūdǐng hòulái gài hǎo le méiyǒu .
pairs.english: After hearing about the West Canal cart, Iven first asked whether the roof had been fixed afterwards.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文听完西渠那辆车的事，先问的是屋顶后来盖好了没有。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō bù zhīdào .
pairs.english: Tavi didn't know.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说不知道。

pairs.target: tāmen nàtiān xiàwǔ ànshí huí le xuégōng , zuìhòu kàndào de shì liǎnggēn línshí mù chēng , gù shīfu hái zài gēn rén shāngliáng liào cóng nǎlǐ lái .
pairs.english: They had returned to the academy on time that afternoon; the last things he saw were two temporary wooden props, with Master Gu still discussing where to get material.
pairs.hanzi: 他们那天下午按时回了学宫，最后看到的是两根临时木撑，顾师傅还在跟人商量料从哪里来。

pairs.target: tā bǎ huà zài zhǐbiān de jǐngkǒu gěi yīwén kàn , yòu bǔ shàng niǎo fēijìnqù de nà yìquān . "
pairs.english: He showed Iven the shaft mouth sketched in the margin, adding the circle the bird had flown.
pairs.hanzi:
他把画在纸边的井口给伊文看，又补上鸟飞进去的那一圈。
“

pairs.target: zhège nǐ méi huà bǐlì . " yīwén shuō . "
pairs.english: “This isn't to scale,” Iven said.
pairs.hanzi:
这个你没画比例。”伊文说。
“

pairs.target: niǎo bùkěn tíngxiàlái ràng wǒ liáng . "
pairs.english: “The bird wouldn't stop to let me measure it.”
pairs.hanzi: 鸟不肯停下来让我量。”

pairs.target: yīwén xiào le , fānguò zhǐ , bèimiàn shì tǎ wéi chāo gěi shào lǐ de biǎo .
pairs.english: Iven laughed and turned the paper over; the back held the tables Tavi had copied for Shaoli.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文笑了，翻过纸，背面是塔维抄给邵里的表。

pairs.target: tā yǐjīng duì guò liǎngbiàn , zhǔnbèi míngzǎo suí xìn sòngchūqù .
pairs.english: He had checked them twice and meant to send them with a letter tomorrow morning.
pairs.hanzi: 他已经对过两遍，准备明早随信送出去。

pairs.target: yīwén tì tā zhǎochū yíchù xiǎoshùdiǎn , nábǐ bǔ dé qīngchǔ xiē , cái bǎ zhǐ hái huílái .
pairs.english: Iven found a decimal point and made it clearer with his pen before returning the sheet.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文替他找出一处小数点，拿笔补得清楚些，才把纸还回来。

pairs.target: wǔtiān qián de yǔ méiyǒu zài xià , xī jiē de kòngdì yǐjīng gān le .
pairs.english: There had been no more rain since five days ago, and the open space at West Steps had dried.
pairs.hanzi: 五天前的雨没有再下，西阶的空地已经干了。

pairs.target: héchàngduì jiè dào nàlǐ de chángdèng hé liǎngmiàn jiù bù píng , bàngwǎn chàng jǐshǒugē , bù shōuqián , shuíyǒukōng dōu néng lái .
pairs.english: The choir had borrowed benches there and two old cloth screens to sing a few songs at dusk, free to anyone with time to come.
pairs.hanzi: 合唱队借到那里的长凳和两面旧布屏，傍晚唱几首歌，不收钱，谁有空都能来。

pairs.target: yīwén wǔhòu jiù qù le , línzǒuqián bǎ tǎ wéi suàn jìn bāng chàng de rén lǐ . "
pairs.english: Iven went after midday, counting Tavi among the supporting singers before he left.
pairs.hanzi:
伊文午后就去了，临走前把塔维算进帮唱的人里。
“

pairs.target: zuìhòu yíduàn . " tǎ wéi tíxǐng tā . "
pairs.english: “The last section,” Tavi reminded him.
pairs.hanzi:
最后一段。”塔维提醒他。
“

pairs.target: jìde . nǐ yàoshi hūrán xiǎng chàng qiánmiàn , wǒ hái dé lán nǐ . "
pairs.english: “I remember. If you suddenly want to sing the beginning, I'll have to stop you.”
pairs.hanzi: 记得。你要是忽然想唱前面，我还得拦你。”

pairs.target: děng tǎ wéihé pà wò zǒu dào xī jiē , bù píng yǐjīng jiàqǐ .
pairs.english: By the time Tavi and Pavo reached West Steps, the cloth screens were up.
pairs.hanzi: 等塔维和帕沃走到西阶，布屏已经架起。

pairs.target: yímiàn dǎngfēng , lìngyímiàn hòutou fàng le dēng , pà wò dàilái de zhǐ yǐng néng zài shàngmiàn tóu chū wāiwāiniǔniǔ de rénxíng .
pairs.english: One blocked the wind; a lamp stood behind the other, letting Pavo's paper silhouettes cast crooked figures on it.
pairs.hanzi: 一面挡风，另一面后头放了灯，帕沃带来的纸影能在上面投出歪歪扭扭的人形。

pairs.target: tā shuō zhǐshì shìyíxià , zhuǎnyǎn jiùràng zhǐrén cháng chū yífù húzi , duān zhe yìzhī bǐ tóu hái dà de wǎn .
pairs.english: He said it was only a trial; in no time his paper man had grown a beard and was holding a bowl bigger than its head.
pairs.hanzi: 他说只是试一下，转眼就让纸人长出一副胡子，端着一只比头还大的碗。

pairs.target: xiǎoháizi xiān wéi le guòqù . yǒu gè nǚhái shuō húzi xiàng sàozhou .
pairs.english: Children gathered first. A girl said the beard looked like a broom.
pairs.hanzi: 小孩子先围了过去。有个女孩说胡子像扫帚。

pairs.target: pà wò biàn ràng zhǐrén dǎo guòlái sǎodì , xiàoshēng cóng píng hòu gǔn dào táijiē shàng , bǎ zhèngzài shìyīn de yīwén xiàleyítiào .
pairs.english: Pavo turned the paper man upside down to sweep the floor; laughter rolled from behind the screen to the steps and startled Iven, who was warming up his voice.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃便让纸人倒过来扫地，笑声从屏后滚到台阶上，把正在试音的伊文吓了一跳。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàn dào duìwu hòupái , kànjiàn nàge xiǎogèzi xīnshēng .
pairs.english: Tavi took his place in the back row and saw the small new student.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维站到队伍后排，看见那个小个子新生。

pairs.target: duìfāng jǐnjǐn zuàn zhe qǔpǔ , xiàbiān de zhǐ yǐjīng juǎn qǐlái .
pairs.english: The boy gripped his music so tightly that its lower edge had curled.
pairs.hanzi: 对方紧紧攥着曲谱，下边的纸已经卷起来。

pairs.target: tā wèn tǎ wéi huì buhuì wàngcí ,
pairs.english: He asked Tavi whether he might forget the words.
pairs.hanzi: 他问塔维会不会忘词，

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō huì , dàn zìjǐ nà jù zhǐyǒu liùgè zì , duìfāng liǎnshàng de xiànmù jiǎnzhí yào yìchū lái .
pairs.english: Tavi said yes, but his own line had only six characters; envy practically overflowed the other's face.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说会，但自己那句只有六个字，对方脸上的羡慕简直要溢出来。

pairs.target: mǐlā hé sū yǐ láide shāowǎn , bào zhe yìbāo chǎo dòu ,
pairs.english: Mira and Suyi arrived a little later, carrying a bag of roasted beans.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉和苏苡来得稍晚，抱着一包炒豆，

pairs.target: zhǎo búdào néng zuòzài yìqǐ de wèizhì , gāncuì kàozhe zuì xiàmiàn yījí táijiē zhàn .
pairs.english: Finding nowhere to sit together, they simply stood against the lowest step.
pairs.hanzi: 找不到能坐在一起的位置，干脆靠着最下面一级台阶站。

pairs.target: mǐlā cháo tǎ wéi jǔqǐ dòubāo , xiàng jǔ zhe yífèn tā zànshí lǐng búdào de shǎngqián .
pairs.english: Mira raised the bean bag toward Tavi like a reward he couldn't collect just yet.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉朝塔维举起豆包，像举着一份他暂时领不到的赏钱。

pairs.target: tiān hái méiyǒu quánhēi .
pairs.english: It wasn't fully dark.
pairs.hanzi: 天还没有全黑。

pairs.target: zuìxiān chàng de shì yìzhī duǎngē , chàng bānjiā shí shénme dōu néng wàng , wéidú bùnéng wàng guō .
pairs.english: They began with a short song about moving house: forget anything except the cooking pot.
pairs.hanzi: 最先唱的是一支短歌，唱搬家时什么都能忘、唯独不能忘锅。

pairs.target: yīwén gānglǐng chū dìèrjù , qiánpái yígè lǎorén biàn gēn le jìnlái , diàozi rào dé bǐ tāmen duō yìquān ,
pairs.english: Iven had barely begun the second line when an old man in front joined in, with a tune that wound around one loop more than theirs.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文刚领出第二句，前排一个老人便跟了进来，调子绕得比他们多一圈，

pairs.target: hòupái de xīnshēng yíxiàzǐ zhuīguòqù , zhěnggè duìwu xiàng bèi rén cóng cèmiàn zhuài le yìbǎ .
pairs.english: The new student in back followed at once, and the whole choir seemed yanked sideways.
pairs.hanzi: 后排的新生一下子追过去，整个队伍像被人从侧面拽了一把。

pairs.target: yīwén de shǒu tíng zài bànkōng .
pairs.english: Iven's hand stopped in midair.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文的手停在半空。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànjiàn tā zuǐjiǎo bēngzhù , zhīdào tā hěn xiǎng bǎ dàjiā jiàotíng .
pairs.english: Tavi saw his mouth tighten and knew he wanted badly to stop everyone.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看见他嘴角绷住，知道他很想把大家叫停。

pairs.target: kě táijiē xià yǐyǒu liǎnggè rén gēn lǎorén yìqǐ chàng , lián bào háizi de nǚrén yě pāi qǐ le xīgài .
pairs.english: But two more people below the steps were singing with the old man, and even a woman holding a child was patting her knees.
pairs.hanzi: 可台阶下已有两个人跟老人一起唱，连抱孩子的女人也拍起了膝盖。

pairs.target: yīwén kàn le kàn duìwu , tūrán bǎshǒu fàng dī , xiān jiē zhù le lǎorén nà yíjù .
pairs.english: Iven looked at the choir, suddenly lowered his hand, and first picked up the old man's line.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文看了看队伍，突然把手放低，先接住了老人那一句。

pairs.target: tāmen pái guò de zhěngqí shēngbù méi le , zhī shèng zhòngrén néng gēnshàng de zhǔdiào .
pairs.english: Their neatly rehearsed parts vanished, leaving only the main tune everyone could follow.
pairs.hanzi: 他们排过的整齐声部没了，只剩众人能跟上的主调。

pairs.target: dìèrbiàn , xīnshēng zhōngyú zhǎohuí zìjǐ de shēngyīn .
pairs.english: On the second round the new student finally found his own voice.
pairs.hanzi: 第二遍，新生终于找回自己的声音。

pairs.target: chàng dào guō cóng chēshàng gǔn xiàpō shí , pà wò de zhǐrén qiàhǎo bǎ wǎn jǔ guòtóu , táijiē shàng yòu shì yízhèn xiào .
pairs.english: As they sang of the pot rolling downhill off the cart, Pavo's paper man happened to raise its bowl overhead, drawing another wave of laughter from the steps.
pairs.hanzi: 唱到锅从车上滚下坡时，帕沃的纸人恰好把碗举过头，台阶上又是一阵笑。

pairs.target: chàng wán , yīwén cháo lǎorén qiàn le qiànshēn .
pairs.english: After the song Iven bowed slightly to the old man.
pairs.hanzi: 唱完，伊文朝老人欠了欠身。

pairs.target: lǎorén shuō nǐmen bǎ zuìhòu yíjù chàng duǎn le , tā zhǐhǎo diǎntóu , shuō xiàhuí qǐng nín xiān jiào .
pairs.english: The old man said they'd cut the last line short; he could only nod and say, next time please teach us first.
pairs.hanzi: 老人说你们把最后一句唱短了，他只好点头，说下回请您先教。

pairs.target: děng zhuǎnhuí duìwu lǐ , tā yòng zhǐyǒu pángbiān néng tīngdào de shēngyīn shuō , nà yíduàn tāmen zúzú liàn le sāngè wǎnshàng .
pairs.english: When he turned back to the choir, he said, quietly enough for only those beside him, that they had practised that passage for three whole evenings.
pairs.hanzi: 等转回队伍里，他用只有旁边能听到的声音说，那一段他们足足练了三个晚上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng ānwèi , yòu juéde shuō " zhèyàng yěhǎo " shízài yǒudiǎn qiànzòu , biàn bǎ shuǐbēi dìguòqù .
pairs.english: Tavi wanted to comfort him, but thought “this is good too” was practically asking to be hit, so he passed the water cup instead.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想安慰，又觉得说“这样也好”实在有点欠揍，便把水杯递过去。

pairs.target: yīwén hēwán , shēnshǒu tuī le tā yíxià , suànshì zhīdào tā xiǎng shuō shénme .
pairs.english: Iven drank, then gave him a shove, as if acknowledging what he had wanted to say.
pairs.hanzi:
伊文喝完，伸手推了他一下，算是知道他想说什么。
《

pairs.target: děng chuán lái pái zài hòumiàn .
pairs.english: Waiting for the Boat came later.
pairs.hanzi: 等船来》排在后面。

pairs.target: lún dào zhè shǒu shí , shān bèihòu de guāng yǐjīng shōu jìn , dēng bǎ bù píng zhào chéng nuǎn huáng .
pairs.english: By then the light behind the mountains had faded entirely, and the lamps turned the screen warm yellow.
pairs.hanzi: 轮到这首时，山背后的光已经收尽，灯把布屏照成暖黄。

pairs.target: yǒurén líkāi qù jiēxià gōng de jiārén , yě yǒurén dài zhe méi chī wán de wǎnfàn gǎnlái , wǎn gē zài xī shàng , kuàizi què tíng le .
pairs.english: Some left to meet family coming off work; others arrived with unfinished suppers, bowls on their knees but chopsticks stilled.
pairs.hanzi: 有人离开去接下工的家人，也有人带着没吃完的晚饭赶来，碗搁在膝上，筷子却停了。

pairs.target: zhèhuí yīwén méiyǒu bǎ kāitóu chàng dé hěnkuài .
pairs.english: This time Iven didn't rush the opening.
pairs.hanzi: 这回伊文没有把开头唱得很快。

pairs.target: yígè shēngbù xiàng cóng jìnàn chūfā , lìng yígè gé le yìxiǎo duàn cái gēnshàng , ràoguò qiántou hái mò luòxià de wěiyīn .
pairs.english: One voice part seemed to set out from the near bank; the other followed after a short gap, winding past the first one's lingering final notes.
pairs.hanzi: 一个声部像从近岸出发，另一个隔了一小段才跟上，绕过前头还没落下的尾音。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dìyīcì tīng tāmen zhèyàng chàng , hūrán juéde nàtiáo gē lǐ de hé bǐ zìjǐ zhàn zhe de kòngdì kuān dé duō .
pairs.english: Hearing them sing this way for the first time, Tavi suddenly felt the river in the song was much wider than the square where he stood.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维第一次听他们这样唱，忽然觉得那条歌里的河比自己站着的空地宽得多。

pairs.target: tā xiǎnxiē wàng le lún dào zìjǐ .
pairs.english: He nearly forgot his entry.
pairs.hanzi: 他险些忘了轮到自己。

pairs.target: xiǎogèzi yòng zhǒu pèng tā , liǎnggè rén yìqǐ bǎ zuìhòu yíjù chàngchūlái , kāitóu dōu dī le yìdiǎn , hòulái cái zhuī shàng .
pairs.english: The small student nudged him; together they sang the final line, both starting a little low before catching up.
pairs.hanzi: 小个子用肘碰他，两个人一起把最后一句唱出来，开头都低了一点，后来才追上。

pairs.target: méiyǒu shuí wèi tāmen dāndú gǔzhǎng .
pairs.english: Nobody applauded them separately.
pairs.hanzi: 没有谁为他们单独鼓掌。

pairs.target: zuìhòu yìshēng luòxià , zhěngpiàn táijiē cái xiǎng qǐlái ,
pairs.english: Only after the last note fell did the whole stairway ring out.
pairs.hanzi: 最后一声落下，整片台阶才响起来，

pairs.target: tǎ wéi de ěrduo fārè , fēnbùqīng shìyīnwèi chàng cuò , háishì yīnwèi zìjǐ yě zài nà yìshēng lǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi's ears burned; he couldn't tell whether from singing wrong or from being part of that sound himself.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维的耳朵发热，分不清是因为唱错，还是因为自己也在那一声里。

pairs.target: sànchǎng hòu , jǐgè rén bǎ chángdèng guī dào jièlái de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Afterwards a few of them returned the benches to where they'd borrowed them.
pairs.hanzi: 散场后，几个人把长凳归到借来的地方。

pairs.target: yīwén bào zhe qǔpǔ , zhàn zài bù píng qián kàn pà wò chāi húzi ,
pairs.english: Holding his music, Iven stood before the screen watching Pavo remove the beard,
pairs.hanzi: 伊文抱着曲谱，站在布屏前看帕沃拆胡子，

pairs.target: bùxǔ tā bǎ nàge dàwǎn zhǐ yǐng dàihuí sùshè tiē zìjǐ chuángtóu .
pairs.english: forbidding him to take the big paper bowl back to the dormitory and stick it above Iven's bed.
pairs.hanzi: 不许他把那个大碗纸影带回宿舍贴自己床头。

pairs.target: mǐlā zhōngyú bǎ dòubāo dìgěi tǎ wéi . lǐmiàn hái shèng yìxiǎo bǎ , quán shì suì de .
pairs.english: Mira finally handed Tavi the bean bag. Only a small handful remained, all broken.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉终于把豆包递给塔维。里面还剩一小把，全是碎的。

pairs.target: sū yǐ shuō wánzhěng de liúbúzhù , yǐjīng jìnlì le .
pairs.english: Suyi said the whole ones couldn't be saved; they'd done their best.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡说完整的留不住，已经尽力了。

pairs.target: tāmen yán liàng zhe chuāng de jiē wǎnghuí zǒu , yīwén yìbiān zǒu yìbiān chóngxīn hēng nà zhī guō de gē , zěnme yě bùkěn zhào lǎorén de rào fǎ .
pairs.english: They walked home along a street of lit windows, while Iven hummed the pot song again, refusing to follow the old man's winding version.
pairs.hanzi: 他们沿亮着窗的街往回走，伊文一边走一边重新哼那支锅的歌，怎么也不肯照老人的绕法。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tì tā jiē le mòwěi , jiēdào yíbàn , bèi zuǐlǐ de dòuzǐ kǎzhù , hāidé wān xiàyāo .
pairs.english: Tavi supplied the ending but halfway through choked on the beans in his mouth and doubled over coughing.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维替他接了末尾，接到一半，被嘴里的豆子卡住，咳得弯下腰。

pairs.target: pà wò shuō xiān bié chàng le , zài chàng xiàqù jīnwǎn dé bǎ rén táihuíqù .
pairs.english: Pavo said to stop singing for now, or they'd be carrying someone home tonight.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃说先别唱了，再唱下去今晚得把人抬回去。

pairs.target: mǐlā xiào dé zǒubúdòng , bǎshǒu dā zài sū yǐ jiānshàng .
pairs.english: Mira laughed too hard to walk and rested a hand on Suyi's shoulder.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉笑得走不动，把手搭在苏苡肩上。
